scope: All eight curated PSX/MSX companies; not the IDX/scaled cohort
selection_policy: Complete PSX/MSX company roster, date eligibility decided from official matched evidence, not numerical labels. Only FFC and Maybank date evidence authenticated in this bounded audit.

benchmark_construction: Interpolated from PSX closing rate summaries; forward-fill after last official date
records.pre_event_caveat: No prespecified independent pre-event baseline; a few event rows, where present, cannot establish a stable estimation period.
records.horizon_caveat: First available post-disclosure close to final available close; omits disclosure-day and first-post-close reaction. Observed dates only, not certified trading-calendar completeness; 30 observations mean 29 intervals, not automatically 30-day return.
